scenicChapters.title: Selent lake shore → Lütjenburg snack stop
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 32 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Lütjenburg snack stop → Hohwacht water stop
scenicChapters.narrative: 19 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

kiel-selent-lake-hohwacht-short-day-and-.story: From Selent it runs 391 km to Damp; allow about 8 h 58 of riding. The stops in between: Lütjenburg snack stop, Hohwacht water stop, Preetz  line and Selent lake shore.
